login.headline: Phone calls for people who can’t hear or speak.
login.subhead: Type and Awaaz speaks for you. What they say appears as captions, with prices and times picked out.
login.footnote: Awaaz tells the other person an assistant is helping, at the start of every call.
login.signInHint: Sign in to make and receive calls.
login.createHint: It takes a minute. You choose how you talk and hear next.
login.devUser: Continue as the dev user (local only)
login.accountCreated: Account created. Check your email for a link to confirm it, then sign in.
login.resetSent: If that email has an account, we sent a link to reset the password.
login.typeEmailFirst: Type your email above first, then tap “Forgot password”.

authErrors.notConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
authErrors.exists: This email already has an account. Try signing in.
authErrors.shortPassword: Use a password with at least 6 characters.
authErrors.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
authErrors.badEmail: That email address doesn’t look right.
authErrors.googleOff: Google sign-in isn’t switched on yet.
authErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.languageHint: Awaaz will use it everywhere, including captions. You can change it any time.
onboarding.title: Let’s set up your calls
onboarding.hint: Two quick questions. You can change everything later in Me.
onboarding.nameHint: This name is said to the other person at the start of every call.
onboarding.howPhone: How do you use the phone?
onboarding.fineTuneHint: Turn on any mix. The first way of talking is your default on calls.

home.title: Calls
home.noCallsBody: Start a call, or try a practice call below to see how captions and replies work.
home.practiceHint: Scripted callers, no real phone call
home.newCallHint: Enter the number you want to call. Awaaz tells them an assistant is helping.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyBody: Save the people and places you call often. Add a note, for example “my BP medicine is Telma 40”, and Awaaz can use it in replies.
contacts.sheetHint: Notes can be used by Awaaz when it suggests replies.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.notesPlaceholder: For example: my BP medicine is Telma 40
contacts.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the number.
contacts.deleteBody: This removes the contact and its notes. Past calls stay in your history.

me.title: Me
me.nameHint: Said to the other person at the start of every call.
me.phrasesHint: Quick things to say on calls

profile.startFromHint: A preset only sets defaults. You can change anything below.
profile.howTalkHint: Choose all that you use. The first one is your default.
profile.howHearHint: Mix freely, for example captions and clear voice together.
profile.disclosure: Tell the other person an assistant is helping
profile.summary: You talk with: {{talk}}{{also}}. You hear with: {{hear}}.

voice.title: Speak, Awaaz says it
voice.hint: I talk into the mic. Awaaz says each sentence on the call, and shows it to me.

help.title: Help me say it
help.hint: A few words in, a clear sentence out. I approve first.

clear.title: Read aloud to me
clear.hint: Each thing they say is read out slowly and at full volume.

summary.title: Summary after the call
summary.hint: What was agreed, with the numbers, that I can read or listen to.

vibe.title: Vibration cues
vibe.hint: The phone buzzes when they start and finish speaking.

translate.title: Translate for me
translate.hint: Read and type in my language, whatever they speak.

phrases.title: My phrases
phrases.said: What is said on the call
phrases.emptyBody: The call screen shows a starter set until you add your own.

history.nothingSaid: Nothing was said on this call.
history.summaryFailed: Could not make a summary right now.

call.draftTitle: Drafted for you. Check it before it’s spoken
call.draftUnclear: Your words were a little unclear. Check this says what you mean.
call.helpPlaceholder: A few words, I’ll make a sentence
call.keypadHint: Press numbers for phone menus, like “press 1 for…”.

blocked.scam_digits: Not sent: Awaaz won’t speak OTP or PIN digits on this call.
blocked.too_long: That message is too long. Please shorten it.

call.micDenied: Allow the microphone to use live voice.
call.voiceListening: Listening. Speak, and Awaaz says it.
call.voiceFailed: Live voice isn’t available right now. You can type instead.

otp_request.title: They asked for your OTP
otp_request.body: Banks never ask for an OTP on a call. Awaaz won’t read out OTPs or PINs on this call.

pin_request.title: They asked for your PIN
pin_request.body: No bank or shop needs your PIN on a call. Awaaz won’t read out PINs or codes on this call.

upi_pin.title: They asked for your UPI PIN
upi_pin.body: Your UPI PIN is only for you. Awaaz won’t read out PINs or codes on this call.

cvv_request.title: They asked for your card’s CVV
cvv_request.body: Never share the CVV on a call. Awaaz won’t read out card details on this call.

remote_app.title: They asked you to install an app
remote_app.body: Never install an app because a caller asks. It lets them see your phone and your bank.

other.title: This may be a scam call
other.body: Be careful. Awaaz won’t read out OTPs, PINs or card details on this call.

errors.draft_failed: I couldn’t draft that. Try different words.
errors.not_available: Help me say it needs the live AI service.
errors.unknown_preview: There’s nothing to confirm any more.
errors.bad_event: Something went wrong. Please try again.
